name: icyteru
description: A simple desktop and Android client for an existing Hermes Agent gateway.
author: Megumiiiiii

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node --test dist/shared/protocol.test.js dist/shared/client.test.js dist/shared/client.api.test.js dist/shared/socket.test.js dist/shared/store.test.js dist/shared/group-order.test.js dist/shared/markdown-inline.test.js dist/shared/chat-activity.test.js dist/shared/model-choice.test.js
scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
